# thumbnails (red style)

Thumbnail templates, 1280 x 720, in three layouts. Use the JPG (under 2 MB) to upload, the PNG master to edit. Everything in [SQUARE BRACKETS] is for you to replace. Keep the bottom-right corner clear: YouTube puts the video length there.
